mapper.sql: chk02_daily_list_id AS daily_list_id, chk02_company_id AS company_id, chk02_class_tree_id AS class_tree_id, chk01_class_tree_nm AS class_tree_name, chk02_content AS content, chk02_explan AS explan, CAST(NULL AS varchar) AS reason, chk02_cutoff AS cutoff, chk02_window_no AS window_no, chk02_seq AS seq, chk02_use_yn AS use_yn, chk02_admin_daily_list_id AS admin_daily_list_id, (chk02_company_id = 0 OR COALESCE(chk02_admin_daily_list_id, 0) <> 0) AS admin_yn
mapper.select: SELECT FROM chk02_daily_list INNER JOIN chk01_class_tree ON chk01_class_tree_id = chk02_class_tree_id WHERE 1=1 AND chk02_class_tree_id IN ( WITH RECURSIVE chk_tree_down(chk01_class_tree_id, chk01_parent_tree_id, depth, path, cycle) AS ( SELECT a.chk01_class_tree_id, a.chk01_parent_tree_id, 0, ARRAY[a.chk01_class_tree_nm::text], false FROM chk01_class_tree a WHERE 1=1 AND chk01_company_id IN (0, #{companyId}) AND chk01_class_tree_id = #{parentTreeId} UNION ALL SELECT a.chk01_class_tree_id, a.chk01_parent_tree_id, b.depth + 1, array_append(b.path, a.chk01_class_tree_nm::text), a.chk01_class_tree_nm = any(b.path) FROM chk01_class_tree a, chk_tree_down b WHERE 1=1 AND a.chk01_parent_tree_id = b.chk01_class_tree_id AND a.chk01_company_id IN (0, #{companyId}) AND NOT cycle ) SELECT a.chk01_class_tree_id FROM chk_tree_down a ) AND chk02_company_id = #{companyId} AND chk02_use_yn LIKE #{useYn} AND UPPER(CONCAT(chk01_class_tree_nm, chk02_content, chk02_explan)) LIKE UPPER(#{searchText}) ORDER BY chk01_seq, chk02_seq
SELECT FROM chk02_daily_list INNER JOIN chk01_class_tree ON chk01_class_tree_id = chk02_class_tree_id WHERE chk02_daily_list_id = #{dailyListId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chk02_daily_list ( chk02_daily_list_id, chk02_company_id, chk02_class_tree_id, chk02_content, chk02_explan, chk02_cutoff, chk02_window_no, chk02_seq, chk02_use_yn, chk02_admin_daily_list_id ) VALUES ( #{dailyListId}, #{companyId}, #{req.classTreeId}, #{req.content}, #{req.explan}, #{req.cutoff}, #{req.windowNo}, #{req.seq}, #{req.useYn}, 0 )
